nonblocking_label_cautions.detail: The source-declared decimal radcn1/radcn2 are evaluated in REAL64 Python for an independent same-grid comparison. This is not an operation-by-operation REAL32 or historical hardcoded table-generation replay; do not attribute residuals solely to scalar roundoff.

The comment calling inferred-fraction level/surface closure independent is narrower than an independent fraction validation. Plan explicitly states diagnostic nonindependent fractions and no pfrac-independent recovery; final interpretation must follow that scope.
